items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) did not practice for the second straight day. Sean McVay said he is not making great progress and team is being cautious; not a long-term concern or hernia.
items.why: Hip/groin; McVay candid on lack of progress
items.implication: Trending toward missing Week 3 vs DEN; Adams monopoly continues

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day.
items.implication: Likely misses Week 3 vs IND; monitor Friday

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery expected; full recovery but ends 2026 season (ACL intact).
items.implication: Winston or free agent QB; impacts all Giants pass catchers ROS

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) missed second straight practice. Looking like he will be without for second consecutive game. Originated Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated W1 after 5-150-1 half.
After good MRI results, Saquon Barkley (stinger) is on the practice field suited up. Expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Stinger; returned W2 briefly; good MRI
items.implication: Lock in as RB1; reverse Bigsby/Shipley stashes

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR after core-muscle surgery; out at least 6 weeks. Pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util through 2 wks), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.implication: Hubbard clear RB2/flex lead; drop Brooks shallow

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown chance and ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Is Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Does Reed absence lead to more 2-TE sets? Can OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.implication: London/Pitts upgrade if Penix effective; Watson/2TE lean; Lloyd fade
items.opportunity: London/Pitts routes if Penix healthy; Watson deep

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 util (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 util through 2 wks with 38% RZ target share; WR9 PPG (16.9) since W11 last year.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; RB37 util. Role not there.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yds to TEs.
